notes.title: Happy birthday, INDEX - 0!
notes.content:
[h1]3 years of Index: Purger[/h1]

Three years ago, i was fooling around in my personal Godot playground in attempt to make some simple First-Person Shooter mechanics, like i did before in Unity. Back then, i didn't even expect what kind of rabbit hole this project is going to be.

[h2]Major Milestones[/h2]

[h3]- Steam Page[/h3]
Of course, Steam is flooded with all games of any kind, to the point when nobody cares. But hey, now we have a page. @ostap_bender, dude, if you wouldn't help me, i'm not sure if this game would ever have one lol. I still owe you this one.

[h3]- 1.495 Tasks Annihilated[/h3]
If i wouldn't have a to-do list, i wouldn't remember what did i do. I have 1.495 untold stories, and... Even if i can tell many of them in detail, i don't think it matters. I just want to tell you that there's a lot of things happening under each little detail of this game. This is labor of my love towards this digital dumpster fire, and i hope i'll make even more *meaningful* tasks next year. I'll try to tell shortly what i did, though.

[h3]- Tools[/h3]
Locational toolset of build 4 was mostly about making static levels. It was fun at first, but the more i was working with game levels for build 4, the more i realized i need more flexible toolset to make more dynamic locations. And... a lot of other things really, such as localization, many other tools to work with this game.

[h3]- Optimization Hell and Detailing[/h3]
Optimization isn't about making existing stuff work better, it is about doing less. You may not fully agree with it, but that was my conclusion when i have added features i wanted to add for a long time, just to find how greedy they can be. That was one of the biggest pitfalls i've encountered in this project. I had to fight literally everything. Fighting for each frame. Fighting loading screen time. Fighting stutters caused by shader compilation. And i'm still not fully sure i've done it well, but at least it runs better now. During this year, i succeeded to add many details, such as particle effects, general-purpose debris on destruction, god knows what else. I don't really want to read through the entire to-do list again, because this application lags when i open my old to-do list with these 1.495 tasks. Just trust me that i had to make a lot of shit to make it into what demo is now, alright?

[h3]- The Loadout Rework[/h3]
Build 4 was the last point when this game had "physical" loadout where you had to interact with props to select weapons. I loved this idea, because it was somewhat original and easy to make. However, it proved to be limiting and i realized i need to add levelling and skills in this game. What's the result? You can now roleplay as meth demigod while playing one of these weird gamemodes introduced by "Mystery" perk. This is one of the biggest changes that turned Purger into what it is now.

[h3]- Demo Released[/h3]
As an actually healthy way to replace "Early Access", i have released demo version. It will represent current state of development. What can i say... I thought this game was well-fixed, but you guys didn't just prove me wrong, you have found the most creepy bugs that were only fixed as soon as 3.6. released. I'm still not sure what kind of anomalies happened, but hey, at least it seems to be stable right now. I'm very, very thankful for all feedback you provided, it was a literal gold mine of it. A lot of conflicting opinions, maybe it all can just burn in hell :)

[h2]Thank You[/h2]

@tipsiey – The OG playtester who brutalized my ego and the game into something better. Your sounds, props, and code are all still here. I hope you'll have fun exploding fire extinguishers whenever you encounter them in future locations.

@ostap_bender – Financial god, playtesting legend, and the reason this project didn’t get into mental hospital. I can't even put into words how much did you help me during this year, even if i fully realize that life is changing for you... I just wanted to thank you again for all these moments we had together while playtesting this game with screensharing.

@thenetherpug – From lightmaps to animation wizardry, you jumped into this mess headfirst and made it shine. At first, when i met you discussing Project-S, i would never tell you'd join this loose collaboration. Despite having a ton of projects to work on, you still managed to do relighting with higher-quality lightmaps, write streaming of resources (and used on lightmaps), write texture quality setting and unlock your viewmodel animation skills to reanimate 4 weapons entirely. You impressed me really much during this year, and i hope i managed to answer all the questions regarding game-dev you might have had.

@dooley_21554 – You came out of nowhere, took my weird English and turned it into poetry while playtesting like a madman. Respect for this, dude, i hope we'll work more together.

@zoltan_szana – The "meth update" joke that turned this game into Silk Road. You deserve to be credited for this.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

The demo’s out, the foundation’s solid(ish), and the vision’s clearer than ever. But Index: Purger isn’t done yet. There’s more to break, more to fix, and more fun to squeeze out of this hellish development project.

Happy birthday, Index-0. Thanks for being here, thanks for reading this.

Happy new cycle, residents of INDEX-0. In honor of this date, we are releasing a relatively major update for the demo, which adds new weapons, enhances the experience and fixes a lot of bugs!

In addition, we are releasing the game's soundtrack for sale! 


List of changes:

- Lowered game file size by 2 GBs
- Add Bender weapons - Mausie, Scorpion, EMP-40, PDW-B-M2, G-612
- Added a \"Normal\" difficulty
- Add loadout closets *everywhere*
- Add motion blur
- Added invert X/Y mouse input settings
- Added \"Sharpen\" option
- Added new perks: Hitman, Highlight, Med. Training
- Added foodpacks
- Footsteps are now more noticeable
- Loadout UI is now showing active mystery modes
- Voicelines removed
- NPCs improvement and optimization
- Updating engine version, which resulted in stability
- Fix arrangement of save list
- Change value for default max fps
- Restart the game on language change
- Multiple displays support added
- Fix variety of bugs related to Items HUD
- Variety of fixes related to a citizen day location
- C4 explosions sound at Get-Inn Mall section (thanks Mister Twister!)
- Bunnyhopping of \"Fast\" perk was tweaked to be smoother
- Toggle sprint/crouch/aim option in input settings
- Fixed low quality settings softlock
- Optimized shader compilation
- Tweaked visuals of certain mystery modes

notes.title: Index: Purger - 3 patches
notes.content:
It's a little late, but here are the past patches! (By the way, 1.0.7 was released on August 10, 2024)

- News window in menu (asked by @ostap_bender)
- Fixed a crash related to usage of drugs like meth
- Fixed applying of perks affecting firerate or ammo damage
- Fixed replicated case of save system bug that broke @youssef_source game session by rewriting certain mechanisms, status of fix is unknown
- Removed x16 anti-aliasing option
- Limited maximum spread
- Fixed positioning of camera on death if you die while crouching
- Fixed loadout selection auto-saving
- Investigated the case of @thenetherpug and accidentally blown my brains off

[h2]PATCH 1.0.6[/h2]
One anonymous individual reported me a lot. If you are reading this - thank you.

- Fix russian news
- Changes to processing of modifications
- Grenade launcher of AR-131 is launching the grenade with more force
- LoadoutSelection became more flexible, but nobody will care about that yet
- Removed "Return to Loadout" menu button

- Changed m_day1_1 a little
- Fixed NPC visibility checks
- Fixed NPC raycast bullets going through walls

- Nerfed gas damage

- NPCs should now move much less
- Removed possibility to open game menu when mission ends
- Difficulty selection menu is changed
- Tutorial scavengers were replaced
- Fixed processing of default settings values
- Removed special abilities from chemical and explosive units
- Sound settings is now applying immediately
- m_day1_3_post0 added more enemies

[h2]PATCH 1.0.7[/h2]
- Fixed patchnotes memory
- Clean up trash in files
- Global values are now saved on closing of game menu
- Fixed the reported location chunk crash
- Fixed the crash caused by picking up some dropped weapon in weird circumstances
- Fixed the crash of loading loadout menu save
- Meth is now free
- Explosion shaking radius is lowered
- Added missing checkpoints to m_day1_1 and m_day1_3_post0

Please, if you can, report any problems that you have discovered yourself, this will help make the game better.

notes.title: Index: Purger, 4 patches in a row
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. I hope all of you had fun with demo of Index: Purger. During these days, i had released 4 patches (and god, i need to get a habit of posting details here too).

Patch v1.0.1:
- Attempted to fix save system (on player death) crash reported by both @Coypu and @eznoobies. The potential reason of this crash (logs say nothing as always) is related to bugged LocationBase reset function. I tried adding more "safety measures", and i really hope it got fixed
- @Youssef reported a weird crash related to switch to last loadout menu, i tried to fix it up according to logs he sent, yet i'm not sure if that fixes it

Patch v1.0.2:
- Fixing the case of @Unnamed Entity that couldn't kill the infinite wave in ClothMan shop. This update is supposed to... fix it i hope.
- Removing gas on save loading. Gas was one of the reasons why spawn-killing has occured as much.
- Attempted to fix save system crash once again, with adding even more to logs.
- Logs are now stored in ./logs directory and each session creates a new log file. If you have a problem with crashes or something like that - send the entire folder.
- Fixed the so-called "Chicken Grandpa" save, now the game should not have problems with processing Not-A-Number values that somehow ended up being character's health.
- Fixed a bug that multiplied usage of bandage item by the count of level transitions.

Patch v1.0.3:
- Adding missing .SO files (and .DYLIB just in case). Doing that mainly for @Tortle | BitFreeze Entertainment, maybe that'll make it easier to launch on MacOS.

Patch v1.0.4:
- Fixed Linux support with help of @Crynux, now the game starts and has visible weapons
- Just in case Linux platform will have debug executable too
- Attempted to test the death mechanic more extensively and add more code to fix it up. I hope that players like @Youssef won't have as much trouble in future
- One of the Steam players (named 2chainz4bracletz) reported a bug. If you die underwater, after respawning you will have suffocation damage anyway... Fixed now
- Reorganized resolution menu to add some missing resolutions (one of which were needed by @Youssef)
- Prevent setting of dangerous resolutions into WindowControl (such as 0 values that break the rendering entirely)
- Tutorial pre-arena saving (asked by @Coypu)
- Version label visible globally in this game (asked by @00::0002 - Бендер)
- Fixed the empty equipment slot bug caused by "hidden" dev. armor

Please, if you can, report the issues you have found yourselves.

notes.title: Index: Purger Progress (Blog #2)
notes.content:
[h1]Happy New Year, dear citizens.[/h1]

It's time to show what we've been working on!

[h1]Streets near the Get-Inn Mall[/h1]
With no comms with anyone, exiting this mall barely alive, You will have to find Your way to escape that sector to survive after this failed operation of Omega Security. Technical name of this game level is m_day1_3_post1, for now it is in development.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790093/deb844b1a5c7641d72a16a38158f20ecee330f05.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790093/665c2ff3e0fe16e3daaa048f7178b448b6f15cdc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790093/f3a4ababcd9bc9870b3dae9e36040964075cebf7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790093/bd001f946b3b4eafba2c508f18bde5f37fbbeacb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790093/b778a6dbb17db669fed3c413d65b49c1126e018e.png[/img]

m_day1_3_post1 is not the simplest game level to make for sure. Before that moment, there were limited, simplistic and brutalistic structures of the mega-mall. In this case, that's a whole cityscape to make, which, of course, requires additional assets to create a more believable experience. Example of such assets are cars:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790093/491f724b39e2fc269e304faf7e4daac2306a3a48.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790093/7f9d764d53f73c0dc0ab38e089d13019bdb70a41.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790093/3840eb64218dbdc764b9979ff89dfd5e3d939e01.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790093/b34b6a7b0a71e40881d488a9ef8d80362dbe4df3.png[/img]

[h1]Stages of development for current time period[/h1]
[list]
[*][h3]Completion of the streets near the Get-Inn Mall[/h3]
Mainly it needs new assets to be developed for mentioned believable atmosphere of the dystopian cityscape. That means creation of visual assets, soundscapes and other details.
[*][h3]Technical maintenance[/h3]
Stability of work of this game is an important element, which means not only the fix of various bugs, but also analysis of work of the game systems and fix of various flaws in optimization of this game to create a more smooth experience. For the time being the game itself is quite stable, however, there is a good bunch of various flaws that need to be fixed.
[*][h3]Weapon development[/h3]
This game has a lot of various weapons, but on screenshots there is only AR-100 because that weapon is the only one that has a nice, textured look, while others mainly being placeholders. The target of this stage of development is turning placeholder weapons to more real weaponry that is possible to show and, of course, which is cool to play with.
[*][h3]Demo[/h3]
This stage is important in a way so it gives an actual possibility to show this game to players, or, to be more precise, to show what kind of game it is, how it feels, how it plays, so it is important to make the demo in a way so all mentioned points are possible within limited demo version of the game. Besides that, such public version of the game can help to gather more feedback that will help to improve the game experience of released version of this videogame.
[/list]

See you soon!

notes.title: Index: Purger Beginning (Blog #1)
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome, Index-0 citizen![/h1]

[h3]In this first piece of news, we'd like to touch on the future of this game, as well as talk about the FAQ.[/h3]
[previewyoutube=I2BDtfySC5w;full][/previewyoutube]



[h1]Game Mechanics[/h1]
In this blog we'll talk about some of the mechanics of the game. Some mechanics are truly gamechanging!


[h1]Loadout[/h1]
Loadout is the most important game mechanic. Here you can choose your equipment, weapons and perks. Customize the equipment for yourself!
We are currently actively working on locations and weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790093/61bc9ec8ae436a7efc206b6692b30572cdfca43d.gif[/img]


[h1]Perks[/h1]
You can also select perks in the loadout. You can choose your own style. Do you want to be a tank or an engineer? The choice is yours alone!
And the "Mystery" perk... He can give you new emotions even after completing the game! Will you be able to guess all the combinations?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790093/52403860269f9c96f4bda3bb204cd14b0df44846.gif[/img]

[h1]Enemies[/h1]
We have a lot of different enemies! From "whipping boys" to heavyweights who need their own approach to be neutralized!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790093/cd8a40a9282f46782e585baa6c3f5da518a832df.gif[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790093/340efb9efdcf12deed8e062f2ba5c9fb1eb66d8e.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790093/340efb9efdcf12deed8e062f2ba5c9fb1eb66d8e.gif[/img][/url]

FAQ 
[list]
[*] [b]Will there be a progression in the game?[/b]
[i]Yes, you will have to earn experience and skill points in the main mission or in additional missions. Using them, you will unlock weapons, equipment, and perks.[/i]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Will there be a demo version of the game?[/b]
[i]Yes, we are planning to make a demo version of the game, which will show the most basic mechanics of the game in a unique short storyline related to the Alpha-0 squad.[/i]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Will there be SteamDeck support?[/b]
[i]We are considering this option. If Valve issues a devkit, we will provide support for SteamDeck.[/i]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]When is the game's release?[/b]
[i]It is impossible to say for sure, but it is planned for 2024.[/i]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Will there be Russian localization?[/b]
[i]If there is a demand for Russian localization after the release, then we will most likely do it. I note that we will not touch the voice acting.[/i]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]If I'm a YouTuber and I want to get the key, then where should I write?[/b]
[i]indexproject.bl@gmail.com you can send a request.[/i]
[/list]
